info.title: Mirr Customer API
info.description: API key authenticated endpoints for building on top of Mirr. Requires Standard or higher with an eligible subscription. See the [workflow guide](/docs/customer-api-workflows.md) for URL-to-video, blog outline approval, polling, credits, and publishing. WordPress publishing is not provided by Mirr.

bearerAuth.description: Use an API key from the Mirr dashboard as a Bearer token.

post.summary: Generate a Google Vids-style editable video document
post.description: Creates a saved editable video. Set reviewBeforeFinalize=true for a free script/scene draft. After review, finalize with generationId and expectedUpdatedAt, then call render separately. Base finalized generation costs 15 credits; delivered AI brand image/video options add 15/30 credits. MCP: video_create_draft. See /docs/customer-api-workflows.md.

Runs deferred voiceover and media work on an approved draft. Pass the latest updatedAt as expectedUpdatedAt. Base generation cost: 15 credits, subject to benefits and media options. Does not render the final MP4: call POST /api/v1/video-lab/render next. MCP: video_finalize.

post.summary: Render a video-lab document to MP4
post.description: Queues a background Remotion Lambda render for a saved generation (poll the generation renderStatus), or renders an ad-hoc document synchronously.

get.summary: List saved Google Vids-style video documents

post.summary: Create an editable blank or source-video document without AI generation

get.summary: Get a saved Video Lab document and render status
get.description: Returns the complete generation document. Browser polling should use /api/v1/video-lab/generations/{id}/render-status, which omits the large document and input media. Only use generation.renderedVideoUrl after renderStatus is completed and the URL is nonempty. Inspect renderError on failure. Pass generation.updatedAt as expectedUpdatedAt to review/finalize/refine operations. MCP video_get exposes these fields at the top level.

Create longform content and start agentic generation
post.description: Starts background research and outline generation. Poll GET /api/v1/longform/{id} until outline_review, then PUT the approved sections to /api/v1/longform/{id}/outline to start writing. Poll for draft/completed or failed. Base generation cost: 10 credits, subject to applicable first-use benefits. Does not publish to WordPress.

get.summary: Get longform content by ID (also used for generation progress polling)

put.summary: Confirm or edit outline, then proceed to content writing
put.description: Submit the complete approved sections from generationSteps.outline, optionally edited, and an optional title. Starts background writing; a successful response is not a completed article. Identical approvals are acknowledged without redispatch; changed outlines or incompatible states return 409 OUTLINE_STATE_CONFLICT. Poll GET /api/v1/longform/{id} for draft/completed or failed. MCP equivalent: blog_confirm_outline.
